_comment: Dayjoy AI Enterprise — n8n credential definitions. Import via n8n UI: Settings → Credentials → Import from File. After import, populate each credential's secret values. The file below ships the SHAPE only — never commit real secrets.
_usage: Each workflow references these credentials by name. Do NOT rename without updating every workflow JSON.

credentials.name: dayjoyApi
_notes: Used by every HTTP Request node calling the Dayjoy backend (/api/*).
JWT minted by POST /api/auth/service-token with role=automation, 90-day expiry.
Rotate via backend audit log; update value here then re-save credential in n8n.

credentials.name: dayjoyApiBaseUrl
_notes: Not a real credential — this is the canonical base URL every HTTP node prepends.
Set DAYJOY_API_BASE_URL env var in the n8n container; HTTP nodes reference {{ $env.DAYJOY_API_BASE_URL }}.
Kept here as documentation; n8n does not import it as a credential.

credentials.name: dayjoyWebhookSecret
_notes: HMAC-SHA256 shared secret used by the Webhook Auth Code node to verify X-Dayjoy-Signature headers.
Must match DAYJOY_WEBHOOK_SECRET on the backend.
Implemented as an n8n 'Static Data' / environment variable lookup — see shared/webhook-auth.md.

credentials.name: dayjoySmtp
_notes: Used by Email Send nodes (welcome emails, follow-up emails, alert emails).
Production: SendGrid (smtp.sendgrid.net:587, user=apikey).
Pre-prod: MailHog (smtp:1025, no auth).

credentials.name: dayjoyWhatsApp
_notes: WhatsApp Business Cloud API credentials.
Used by WhatsApp send nodes in lead follow-up, customer welcome, and support workflows.
Verify token is used when Meta calls our webhook for verification — not for outbound sends.

credentials.name: dayjoySlack
_notes: Used by the global error-alert workflow and any workflow that posts to Slack channels.
Bot token scopes required: chat:write, chat:write.public, channels:read.
Default alert channel: #dayjoy-automation-alerts.

credentials.name: dayjoyGoogleCalendar
_notes: Used by calendar workflows (Agent — calendar scope) for follow-up scheduling and meeting creation.
Complete OAuth flow in n8n UI after import: credential → 'Connect' → sign in as dayjoy-automation@dayjoy.ai.
Service account recommended for production; convert to JWT auth in n8n if needed.

credentials.name: dayjoyTwilio
_notes: Used by SMS send nodes (urgent lead HOT notifications, after-hours alerts).
india-compliant long code recommended; verify DLT template registration before go-live.

credentials.name: dayjoyOpenAI
_notes: Used by AI scoring, customer enrichment, and sales forecast workflows when calling OpenAI directly.
When the backend AI proxy (/api/ai/...) is used instead, this credential is NOT required — the dayjoyApi JWT authorizes.

_environmentVariables.N8N_ENCRYPTION_KEY: <32-byte hex — required by n8n to decrypt stored credentials>
_environmentVariables._notes: Set these in the n8n container environment (docker-compose env_file or k8s Secret).
